value: This article provides an overview of Carnegie Mellon's School of Computer Science (SCS), a globally recognized, premier institution dedicated to training future innovators. It highlights SCS's comprehensive educational programs, from undergraduate to executive and online certificates, alongside its extensive research endeavors conducted across specialized departments like Machine Learning, Robotics, and Human-Computer Interaction. SCS ultimately aims to equip students and faculty to solve real-world problems and enhance societal well-being.
